description: Tauri system-tray daemon — tray icon, right-click context menu, and native OS notifications. No primary window ships by default.

buildHints.whenToUse: Pick tauri-tray when the app is a headless background daemon with no primary window — tray icon + context menu + OS notifications only. Classic: Dropbox sync, Slack notifier, build-status watcher. If the user needs a popover panel, use tauri-menubar. If they need a real window, use tauri-desktop.
firstSteps: Run `pnpm install` then `cargo tauri dev` — the daemon registers a tray icon and the context menu is live.
Template variables ({{crateName}}, {{projectName}}, {{packageName}}) are substituted automatically at compose time.
Add real icons via `pnpm tauri icon <source.png>` — generates into src-tauri/icons/ and auto-wires them in tauri.conf.json. Until then the tray falls back to a transparent placeholder.
Extend `on_menu_event` in src-tauri/src/lib.rs with business logic; add `#[tauri::command]` functions for async work.
Run `node preview-server.mjs` (or `pnpm preview:instant`) for a static HTML preview of the tray menu without a Rust build.
gotchas: macOS: ActivationPolicy::Accessory is set in .setup() — without it you get both a dock icon AND a tray icon.
macOS notifications require NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription in Info.plist (via bundle.macOS in tauri.conf.json) and explicit user permission on first send — handle the denial case.
Linux (GNOME 45+): tray icons require the AppIndicator GNOME extension; document this since Tauri silently fails on stock GNOME.
build.rs must call tauri_build::build() — without it the Rust compile fails even though the build-dep is listed in Cargo.toml.
Windows: tray-only apps without a window can trigger AV heuristics — sign the binary and submit to Microsoft SmartScreen via Partner Center.
architectureNotes: No webview window ships by default — the app is pure Rust with a tray surface.
Business logic lives in Tauri commands (#[tauri::command]) invoked from the Rust menu handler — keeps dispatch testable.
Lazy webview: create a hidden webview window programmatically if a settings pane is needed later. Set visible:false in tauri.conf.json to avoid flash-on-start.
Plugin calls (notification, autostart, log) are made from Rust, so no Tauri capability JSON files are required for this default shape.

placeholders.description: {{crateName}} — snake_case crate name (e.g. my_tray_app). Substituted at compose time.
{{projectName}} — used as tray tooltip and notification sender. Substituted at compose time.
{{projectName}} and {{packageName}} — app display name and bundle identifier. Substituted at compose time.
